Id1.text: Dr. G.P. Prabhukumar is the director of The Acharya Institute of Technology (est. 2000), located in Soldevanahalli, Acharya Dr. Sarvapalli Radhakrishnan Road, Hessarghatta Main Road, Bangalore - 560090. The All India Council for Technical Education in Mumbai gave the status of Technical Campus to the Acharya Institute of Technology in Bangalore.

Id2.text: The campus of the Acharya Institute of Technology, designated as a 'Technical Campus' by then All India Council for Technical Education of Mumbai, was established in the year 2000. It is directed by Dr. G. P. Prabhukumar and may be found at Soldevanahalli, Acharya Dr. Sarvapalli Radhakrishnan Road, Hessarghatta Main Road, Bangalore – 560090.

Id3.text: Dr. G. P. Prabhukumar is the director of the Acharya Institute of Technology, which was established in the year 2000 and is located in the city of Bangalore. The campus address is: Soldevanahalli, Acharya Dr. Sarvapalli Radhakrishnan Road, Hessarghatta Main Road, Bangalore - 560090. The All India Council for Technical Education, located in Mumbai, was proud to give the Technical Campus status to the Acharya Institute of Technology.
